correctness.rationale: TARGET disproof verified end-to-end against Kaad-Kyed memoir source. Vertical formula D^V_t and horizontal D^H_q transcriptions match arXiv:2205.06043 Sec 4.1; joint blocks V^n_ij and circle weights match Sec 3.5; pairings <k>,<e>,<f> match Sec 3.1/3.3. For j=0, V^n_{i0}={(lambda u^n_{i0},0)} is 1-dim since u^n_{i,-1}=0. Pairing computation <ek^{-1},u^n_{l0}>=sum_r<e,u^n_{lr}><k^{-1},u^n_{r0}> vanishes because <e,.> forces r=l+1 while diagonal <k^{-1},.> forces r=0, impossible for l>=0; hence D^H_{1/2}=0 on V^n_{i0}. Vertical weight m=-n gives e_n=(t^{n+1}-1)/(t^{-1}-t); at t0=1/2, e_n in [-2/3,-1/2], ->-2/3, |e_n|>=1/2. Normalized psi_{n,i} form orthonormal sequence (Schur orthogonality, Haar norms>0) of D-eigenvectors, hence |D|-eigenvectors. Trace monotonicity gives Tr(|D|^{-x})>=sum_{n<=N}(n+1)|e_n|^{-x}->infinity quadratically for every real x; reproduced script gives S_2000 up to 1.2e8. Hence no half-plane Re(z)>R of convergence exists for b=1 in unital B, falsifying universal meromorphic 1-2-3 claim. Complex-zeta nuance does not affect headline since real half-plane already empty.
